description: Final page of a formal letter from Rep. Adam B. Schiff, closing an appeal to an online platform (Google is named) about handling harmful health misinformation. It urges the platform to inform users who viewed removed false content and direct them to authoritative, medically accurate resources, and ends with Schiff's signature over the title Member of Congress. Context suggests his April 2020 coronavirus-misinformation letter to Google/YouTube.
text: engage with harmful information on your platform, to proactively inform them and direct them to authoritative, medically accurate resources. While taking down harmful misinformation is a crucial step, mitigating the harms from false content that is removed requires also ensuring that those users who accessed it while it was available have as high a likelihood of possible of viewing the facts as well. I recognize the complex challenges that misinformation presents to online platforms such as Google, in this and many other contexts. As we grapple with this unprecedented health situation, I hope you will consider this suggestion for keeping users better informed. Thank you for your attention to my concerns, and I look forward to continuing our ongoing dialogue on these important issues. Sincerely,. Adam B. Schiff. Member of Congress
flags: Only the final page is shown; the addressee and date are not visible in the image — Google is inferred from the letter body

description: Screenshot of a verified tweet from Rep. Adam Schiff (@RepAdamSchiff) announcing letters he sent to the CEOs of Google, YouTube and Twitter urging them to proactively inform users who interacted with medical misinformation. Two attached images show pages of the letters, addressed to Sundar Pichai/Susan Wojcicki and to Jack Dorsey, each signed Adam B. Schiff, Member of Congress. Circa April 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic.
text: Adam Schiff. @RepAdamSchiff. Misinformation is dangerous. Misinformation about public health is deadly. I sent a letter to the CEOs of @Google, @YouTube and @Twitter urging them to proactively inform users when they've interacted with medical misinformation. They can help save lives. [attached letter pages, partially legible:] Mountain View, CA 94043. San Bruno, CA 94066. Dear Mr. Pichai and Mr. Wojcicki: As we all work to combat the COVID-19 pandemic, I want to thank you for the actions you have taken... Jack Dorsey. Chief Executive Officer. Twitter, Inc. 1355 Market Street, Suite 900. San Francisco, CA 94103. Dear Mr. Dorsey:... Sincerely,. Adam B. Schiff. Member of Congress
flags: The embedded letter pages are thumbnail-sized; their body text is only partially legible and transcribed in part

description: Screenshot of an article excerpt embedding a verified Kayleigh McEnany tweet criticizing Rep. Adam Schiff. The tweet claims Schiff used 'parody' to facilitate lies about Donald Trump and includes a C-SPAN3 video thumbnail from a House Intelligence Committee hearing on the whistleblower complaint, showing Rep. Mike Turner (R-OH) and Acting DNI Joseph Maguire. A headline above frames it as a reminder of 'Schiff's lies' in the impeachment hearing.
text: Here's a good reminder of Schiff's lies in the House Impeachment Hearing. Kayleigh McEnany. @kayleighmcenany. WATCH Adam Schiff claim to be using "parody" to facilitate his LIES about @realDonaldTrump. This guy is SICK! Schiff apparently thinks he's a comedian rather than Chairman of the House Intelligence Committee... LIVE. REP. MIKE TURNER (R-OH). JOSEPH MAGUIRE. WHISTLEBLOWER COMPLAINT. flags: The tweet's characterization of Schiff as lying is the author's claim, not established fact; the headline is partisan commentary

description: Stylized graphic based on the iconic World War II flag raising on Iwo Jima: silhouetted Marines raise the U.S. flag atop a dark rocky summit under dramatic storm clouds, with a distressed film-grain treatment on the edges. Large typewriter-style caption reads 'In It Together'. The imagery closely resembles the Flags of Our Fathers film artwork recaptioned as a solidarity message.

Small cropped screenshot of Q-drop-style text on a dark background concerning Michael Flynn, posted around the May 2020 DOJ move to drop his case. Short staccato lines say Flynn was targeted, ask why, and state he was cleared of all charges, with 'v2' highlighted after 'TRUMP ADMIN'. A final line is cut off at the bottom edge; the visible fragment appears to begin 'Election theft'.
text: FLYNN. Targeted. Why? Who knows where the bodies are buried? CLEARED OF ALL CHARGES. TRUMP ADMIN v2?
flags: The claims in the text are the post's assertions, not established fact
Bottom line of text is cropped mid-sentence and not fully transcribed
